narration:
Toh aapne abhi dekha - Bharat ke pehle supercomputer ka naam Param 8000 tha.
Ab suniye uske peeche ki adbhut kahani.
Aapko ye jaan kar hairani hogi ki Bharat ka pehla supercomputer PARAM 8000 kisi videshi company ne nahi, balki kuch Bhartiya engineers ne “America se na sunne ke baad” banaya tha.

Ye baat hai 1987 ki jab Bharat ko mausam, raksha aur antariksh se judi research ke liye ek supercomputer chahiye tha.
Us samay America ke paas unka banaya hua supercomputer Cray X-MP tha, jo ki us samay ka sabse tez supercomputer bhi tha.
Bharat ne America se ye computer maangne ki koshish kari, par America dene ko taiyaar nahi tha, aur seedha bol diya   NO.
Bas, fir kya tha, kahani yahin se palti.

Aur tab ke Pradhanmantri Rajiv Gandhi ne ek yuva vaigyaanik ko bulaya   Dr. Vijay Bhatkar.
Aur kaha, “Agar wo nahi denge, to hum khud banayenge. Humein aatmanirbhar banna hai.”

Lekin sochiye   1987 mein, jab na internet tha, na koi advanced technology tab…
Us daur mein Bharat ne apna khud ka supercomputer banane ka faisla kiya!
Pune mein C-DAC yaani Centre for Development of Advanced Computing ki sthapna hui  
Kuch darjan yuva vaigyaanikon ne team shaamil ki, 18-18 ghante mehnat ki, sirf ek mission lekar ki Bharat ko supercomputer rashtra banana hai.

Teen saal tak, koi chhutti nahi, koi guide nahi  
Har purza, har circuit, har code Bhartiya dimaag se likha gaya.

Phir aaya 1991   wo aitihasik din jab Bharat ne duniya ko chaunka diya.
Launch hua PARAM 8000   “PARAM” jiska Sanskrit arth hota hai “Sarvochch.”
Ye tha Bharat ka pehla swadeshi supercomputer, jiski gati thi 1 gigaflop  
yaani ek arab gannanaayein prati second!

Aur dilchasp baat?
America, jinhone supercomputer dene se mana kiya tha,
usi ne baad mein PARAM kharidne ki ichha jatayi!

PARAM 8000 bana Aatmanirbhar Bharat ki safalta ki kahani,
aur is din ke baad se Dr. Vijay Bhatkar ko “Father of Indian Supercomputing” kaha gaya.
